rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: The closing address, dated only 'July 1991' and captioned 'ANC President Nelson Mandela', says 'You have entrusted me with the presidency of the ANC', calling it a daunting task; it speaks of 'This executive we have just elected' and 'The leadership we have elected here today', and says 'During the past five days we have witnessed a process' that set a standard for democratic participation.

locator.section: Heading 'JULY 1991' and caption line; section 'Daunting task', first sentence; paragraph beginning 'We have had the privilege'; paragraphs containing 'This executive we have just elected' and 'The leadership we have elected here today'

rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: In the same address Mandela recounts that in February 1990 Tambo, recuperating in a Swedish clinic, offered to resign as President and Mandela declined, asking him to leave the question to the next conference; 'as I told you the other day', Tambo later approached the NEC to say he was not available to serve, and 'We then released him'.
